## Kyoto Family Trip at a Glance
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A 5-day Kyoto plan for **1 adult + 1 child (age 9)**, built around **temples, easy walking, vegetarian meals, and one low-transit day**.
Budget target: **¥180,000 total** excluding international flights, with a comfortable mix of sightseeing, transit, food, and a little flexibility.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Budget Split
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Day | Neighborhood focus | Plan | Transit tip | Rough spend |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | Higashiyama / Gion | Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Ninenzaka, Yasaka Shrine, Maruyama Park | Use bus + short walks; taxis are useful for the steepest uphill stretch | ¥32,000 |
| Day 2 | Arashiyama | Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, riverside stroll, Togetsukyo Bridge, monkey park only if energy allows | Go early by train to avoid crowds; keep the day on foot once there | ¥34,000 |
| Day 3 | Northern Kyoto | Kinkaku-ji, Ryoan-ji, Ninna-ji, relaxed café break | Best by taxi or bus combo; cluster temples to reduce transfers | ¥30,000 |
| Day 4 | Southern Kyoto, low-transit day | Fushimi Inari main route, Fushimi sake district walk, easy return to hotel for rest | Keep this as your lightest transit day: one rail line each way, then mostly walking | ¥31,000 |
| Day 5 | Central Kyoto / Nishiki | Nishiki Market, Teramachi, Shinkyogoku, Kyoto Imperial Palace area or a final temple revisit | Stay central and use subway/walking; ideal for souvenir shopping and flexible timing | ¥25,000 |
| Flex / buffer | Citywide | Snacks, extra taxi, rainy-day change, admission overruns | Reserve this for comfort and schedule protection | ¥28,000 |

## 5-Day Kyoto Plan with Neighborhood Suggestions
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

### Day 1: Higashiyama and Gion classics
- **Morning:** Start at **Kiyomizu-dera** when it opens, then walk downhill through **Sannenzaka** and **Ninenzaka**.
- **Afternoon:** Continue to **Yasaka Shrine** and a slow loop through **Maruyama Park**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Continue to **Yasaka Shrine** and a slow loop through **Maruyama Park**, Kyoto, Japan
- **Food:** Vegetarian lunch near Higashiyama; look for **tofu set meals**, **yuba**, or a **shojin ryori** lunch.
- **Transit tips:** This area is best done on foot; use a taxi only for the uphill start if needed.
- **Budget note:** Temple entries, local transit, and a nicer first-night dinner make this a slightly higher-spend day.

### Day 2: Arashiyama for a scenic, easy-walk day
- **Morning:** Arrive early for the **Bamboo Grove** and **Tenryu-ji** before the crowds build.
- **Afternoon:** Cross **Togetsukyo Bridge** and enjoy the riverside paths; skip the monkey park if the child is already tired.
- **Food:** Choose a **vegetarian noodle shop** or tofu lunch
